name: Free Supply of Rice to the Poor People
benefit: 10 kg of free rice is supplied through fair-price shops during natural calamities and on two important festive occasions every year.
_eligibility_text:
- The applicant should be a citizen of India.
- The applicant should be a native of the Union Territory of Pondicherry by birth or continuous residence for not less than 5 years.
- The applicant should belong to the 'Below Poverty Line' category.
